instruction: Implement ranges.intersect(left, right) for bounded version ranges. Each version has three canonical ASCII integer components 0..999 separated by periods, with no leading zero except zero. A range has one or two comparator tokens separated by exactly one space: at most one lower (> or >=) and at most one upper (< or <=). A sole =VERSION is also valid. Reject malformed syntax, repeated bounds, or = combined with another token with ValueError. Intersect the two intervals, returning None if empty; otherwise return {"lower": [version_string, inclusive_bool] or None, "upper": [version_string, inclusive_bool] or None}. Versions compare numerically by components. A contradictory interval is valid syntax but empty. Inputs are strings; no prerelease/build syntax.
